statement: theorem regret_variable_bound (V : Domain (E := E)) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x₁ : E) (p : SupportPolicy (E := E)) (hx₁ : x₁ ∈ V.carrier) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hη : ∀ t < T, 0 < η t) (hmono : ∀ t, t + 1 < T → η (t + 1) ≤ η t) (hloss : ∀ t < T, BanditRL.OnlineSubgradientDescent.SubdifferentiableOn V (loss t)) (hlegal : LegalFeedback V η loss x₁ p T) (D : ℝ) (hdiam : ∀ x ∈ V.carrier, ∀ y ∈ V.carrier, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V.carrier) : regret V η loss x₁ p u T ≤ D ^ 2 / (2 * η (T - 1)) + (∑ t ∈ range T, η t / 2 * ‖selected V η loss x₁ p t‖ ^ 2) - ‖output V η loss x₁ p T - u‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η (T - 1))
source_assumptions: (hmono : ∀ t, t + 1 < T → η (t + 1) ≤ η t)
(hlegal : LegalFeedback V η loss x₁ p T)
(hdiam : ∀ x ∈ V.carrier, ∀ y ∈ V.carrier, ‖x - y‖ ≤ D)
